customerOutcome: Inspect the original current task and its independently reviewed saved draft.
entryConditions: Current authenticated principal and company selection; no retained foreign-principal payload
Effective feature admission is required for new work; native membership and resource authority remain necessary
An account/capability recheck hides private state and controls; same-account resolution requires a new Native read before presentation resumes.
exitConditions: Only a canonical server-confirmed result permits a success claim
Pending, stale, unavailable or unqualified work never becomes successful or activated

content.supportingCopy: Inspect the original current task and its independently reviewed saved draft.
displayedState: Current original Native worker review and exact successful package activation/run/task/output references
A withdrawn/currently unavailable result hides private output links, use-result controls and success headings
Independent draft verification does not establish revenue, savings or other business impact

primary.label: Use result
primary.operation: Complete the original onboarding owner only after the exact current Native worker review, installation, task, run and output pins pass again.

secondary: Open the original task and saved output under its current native authorization
Refresh the original onboarding source after uncertainty; metadata recording creates no new run or grant

canonicalReadDomains: Existing company_onboarding_runs activation state/version and current verified creator membership
Original current package installation, licensed/purpose-approved Native authority and exact successful heartbeat/worker attempt
Original passing human worker verification, current completion contract, privacy/source pins and saved task document revisions
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Typed record_verified_result and complete_activation commands update only the existing onboarding owner after current Native proof, exact request hash and version checks. Safe first-task creation/execution, material access and full launch qualification remain separate/open.
systemWork.authorityEffect: No new execution, credentials, permissions, package activation or business-impact claim. Current original Native authority is checked independently.
systemWork.asyncWork: Private Native reads and existing onboarding metadata only. Five-second Native read guard; original request/version replay.
systemWork.receipt: Exact original Native task/run/installation/worker-review/output references; the original database-clock first-value timestamp is not renewed on replay.

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: Explain an actual empty authorized result. Missing dependencies or qualified capabilities are separate unavailable states.
states.partial: Retain trustworthy available results and name unavailable dependencies or sources.
states.stale: Remove executable actions and refresh canonical state; preserved input is not evidence of current authority.
states.validation_error: Preserve other entered values, identify the field problem and associate it programmatically with the control.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Re-resolve canonical state/version and the original request identity before permitting another effect. A mutation acknowledgement that crosses an account-authority check cannot advance the page; explicit reconciliation retains the original request identity.
states.success: Announce only the server-confirmed canonical result. First value additionally requires independently verified native artifact/run binding.

navigation.back: Browser and product Back preserve session form state without recreating organizations, agents or runs. A same-account recheck retains the unsaved draft only in the mounted account scope; another principal never inherits it.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: No input is written to browser persistent storage; committed activation drafts remain in the native onboarding owner.
navigation.resume: Reload the original current onboarding owner. A recorded result is shown only while its exact Native evidence still qualifies; withdrawn evidence never authorizes completing setup.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Current creator/company-authorized original task title and minimal Native output references; no output body, reviewer identity or private review rationale
Withdrawn/denied results remove original title and result links
dataCollected: Only explicit fields and the published safe-context allowlist
sensitiveFields: Raw intent, company facts, feedback and results remain customer data
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Exclude customer prose, prompts, result bodies, attachments and raw errors from generic analytics/activity details; native domain audit is purpose-separated.

functional: Verify canonical state, version conflicts, safe replay, unavailable states and principal/company switching on the exact artifact.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify current membership/resource revocation, tenant isolation, untrusted content and separate private feedback identity purpose.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
